steps.cap: A memory stack sits beside the GPU on a shared silicon base. It starts with a base chip, which controls the memory chips above it.
Each memory chip is ground to about 30 micrometers, thinner than a human hair.
Twelve chips are joined by dots of solder, and copper-filled holes run straight down through all of them.
The stack has to fit under the cooling plate. Twelve chips reach 0.72 mm, the old limit. HBM4 raised the limit to 775 micrometers and fits up to sixteen chips.
An HBM3E stack talks to the processor over 1,024 wires at once, sixteen times as many as a PC memory module. HBM4 doubles that to 2,048.
